ev.q: charged by the fairy Tear to run an item shop out of her house
bargaining and haggling with clients for goods
accompanying an adventurer into randomly generated dungeons to acquire goods to sell
Recettear takes place in a fantasy setting
frequently funny in an internet message board kind of way
the tone is bubbly and frequently funny
with the goal of paying back the debt within a fixed deadline
found the dungeon crawling somewhat repetitive
the player can continue the game indefinitely
allowing for improvement of the shop and selling benefits once higher levels are gained
